	AND MESSAGE_TYPE = '0110'
    AND TRAN_END_TIME LIKE '202402201041%'
	AND INTERNAL_RESP_CODE = 'JD'
	AND BANKNET_REF_NBR = 'MCC0000C9'
    AND AUTH_NBR IS NULL
    AND RECV_ID IS NULL;

SELECT TOP(5)* FROM D360.STG_CCD_CBCEXTXLGP;

    AND convert(numeric(14,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_END_TIME],' ',''),''),0)) LIKE '202402201041%'
    AND INTERNAL_RESP_CODE = 'JD'
	AND BANKNET_REF_NBR = 'MCC0000C9'
